fusions.name: Byre Leeching
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A headbutt that deals 8 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lowing in the Dark
fusions.desc: Lets out a low bellow 4 tiles ahead of you that deals 11 resonating damage to everything in it, stuns them for 1 second, and leaves them [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Echoing Hide
fusions.desc: Sends 30% of the damage that reaches you back to whoever dealt it for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Grazing
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%. Your armour rises by 5%.
